_meta.prepared_for: Souveno AI (souveno.ai / souveno.in) — WhatsApp quote-to-cash and agentic automation for quote-heavy Indian B2B manufacturers & distributors

icp_segments.D: Auto parts / auto ancillary / job work
icp_segments.P: Pipes / HDPE / PVC / ducts (flagship live client vertical)

scoring.icp_fit: 0-40  share of audience that is a quote-heavy B2B manufacturer/distributor
scoring.competition_noise: 0-10  fewer WhatsApp/CRM SaaS vendors on the floor = higher
scoring.timing_fit: 0-10  fit with the 90-day plan, clashes, travel fatigue
scoring.stars: total/20 rounded to nearest 0.5, floor 1, cap 5
scoring.note: All component scores are the agent's estimates from public data plus Souveno's own ICP documents. Footfall figures are organiser claims unless marked 'audited'.

funnel_assumptions.source: Barakah Systems validation report targets: >=30% of qualified demos accept a paid pilot

events.name: PAPEXPO 2026
events.why: Packaging converters and paper traders quote on WhatsApp all day (size x material x qty). Home city, zero travel cost.

stall.recommend: visit only (walk every packaging-machinery row; exhibitors are the ICP)
stall.hall_hint: Single hall; converters cluster near the machinery demos

events.name: WAREMAT Expo 2026
events.organiser: Midaas Touch Events and Trade Fairs
events.why: Distributors and 3PL owners with stock-aware quoting pain. Cheap half-day visit.

stall.recommend: visit only
stall.hall_hint: n/a

events.name: International Hardware Fair India 2026

footfall_history.note: agent estimate; organiser reports 'over 10,000 trade visitors'

events.why: Hardware and fastener distributors from Delhi NCR, Ludhiana, Jalandhar and Rajkot in one hall: ICP segment A, the highest-priority cluster in the validation report.

stall.recommend: visit this year; exhibit in 2027 if Oct pipeline needs NCR
stall.hall_hint: Halls 5-6 lower ground; corner stall near Gate 10 entry

hotels.name: Bloomrooms @ New Delhi Railway Station
hotels.why: Metro to Supreme Court station in 12 min

hotels.name: Hotel Palace Heights
hotels.why: Walk to Rajiv Chowk metro, one stop change to Blue Line

hotels.name: The Lalit New Delhi
hotels.why: Closest full-service hotel to Pragati Maidan

events.name: Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026
events.organiser: Govt. of Karnataka (Dept. of Electronics, IT & BT)
events.why: Not a buyer show for Souveno. Go for ERP/Tally consultants, BSPs, investors and a possible speaking slot; skip if the Pune trip needs the budget.

stall.recommend: do not exhibit; 1-day delegate pass
stall.hall_hint: Startup pavilion for partner hunting

hotels.name: Holiday Inn Express Bengaluru Yeshwantpur
hotels.why: Green Line metro straight to Madavara (BIEC) station

hotels.name: Taj Yeshwantpur
hotels.why: Best full-service option on the BIEC side of the city

events.name: EngiExpo Pune 2026
events.category: Industrial engineering: machinery, tooling, fasteners, automation
events.venue: PIECC (Pimpri Chinchwad International Exhibition & Convention Centre)

footfall_history.note: organiser claim per edition: 500+ exhibitors, 50,000+ verified industrial visitors

events.why: Pune-Chakan auto-ancillary and job-work owners are ICP segment D; exhibitors themselves are fastener and component makers (segment A). Free visitor registration keeps the crowd owner-heavy.

stall.recommend: exhibit: 9 sqm shell scheme, corner
stall.hall_hint: Ask for the 'Automation & Software' row nearest the main entrance; corner stall numbers ending in 01 or the row's last number

hotels.name: Ginger Pune Pimpri
hotels.why: Cheapest reliable option on the PCMC side

hotels.name: Courtyard by Marriott Pune Chakan
hotels.why: Closest branded hotel to PIECC Moshi; industrial guests

hotels.name: Sayaji Hotel Pune
hotels.why: If you also have Hinjawadi meetings

exhibitor_contact.how: email or online stall booking on engiexpo.com

events.name: Big 5 Global 2026
events.why: Gulf building-material traders quote on WhatsApp too, but the strategy docs say 'prove India first'. Clashes with EngiExpo Pune (23 Nov). Only worth it if 2 Gulf pilots are already in discussion.

stall.recommend: visit only, 2 days (24-25 Nov) via Pune-Dubai direct
stall.hall_hint: Sheikh Saeed Halls for MEP/electrical; Za'abeel for building materials

events.name: GITEX Global 2026
events.why: Huge but noisy; every WhatsApp SaaS competitor is on the floor. Useful only to meet Gulf BSPs, resellers and investors. Low priority.

stall.recommend: skip unless a partner sponsors a pod in the India pavilion
stall.hall_hint: India pavilion / Expand North Star for startups

events.name: EngiExpo Ahmedabad 2026
events.category: Industrial engineering: machinery, tooling, fasteners, automation
events.why: Ahmedabad-Rajkot is India's densest cluster of owner-run pipe, pump, fastener and machinery makers: segments A, E and P together. Gujarati owners run sales on WhatsApp voice notes, which is Souveno's demo.

stall.recommend: exhibit: 9-12 sqm corner on the main aisle
stall.hall_hint: Open-ground layout: choose the row between the entrance gate and the food court; avoid the far end near generators

hotels.name: Lemon Tree Hotel Ahmedabad
hotels.why: Business hotel, easy for client dinners

exhibitor_contact.how: email or online stall booking on engiexpo.com

events.name: Gulf Print & Pack 2027
events.why: Only if a Gulf packaging pilot is live by January. Otherwise a 2.5-star trip that costs a Plastivision stall.

stall.recommend: skip in 2027
stall.hall_hint: n/a

events.name: Plastivision India 2027

footfall_history.note: AIPMA reported figures; organiser projects 250,000 for 2027

events.why: The single best show for Souveno: HDPE/PVC/DWC pipe and duct makers (your flagship live vertical, PSL Polymers and Main Stream Ducts) plus packaging converters, all owner-led, once every four years.

stall.recommend: exhibit: 12-18 sqm corner, book early (halls sell out)
stall.hall_hint: Pipes & profiles are usually clustered in Hall 1-2 near the main Goregaon gate; take a corner on the cross-aisle that links the pipe zone to the machinery halls

hotels.name: The Westin Mumbai Garden City
hotels.why: Adjacent to the venue; client meetings in the lobby

events.name: ACETECH Hyderabad 2027

footfall_history.note: agent estimate; organiser claims are far higher and not audited

events.why: Tiles, sanitary, plumbing and electrical dealers (segment B) in your home city; no hotel, no flight. Clashes with Plastivision and IMTEX, so split days.

stall.recommend: exhibit 9 sqm shell; staff it with the CTO while you fly to Mumbai on 21-22 Jan
stall.hall_hint: Hall 1 near registration; avoid Hall 3 far wall

events.name: IMTEX 2027 + Tooltech + Digital Manufacturing

footfall_history.note: IMTMA reported 1,180+ exhibitors; visitors ~1 lakh over 7 days

score.decision_makers_note: MDs of tool rooms and machine builders

events.why: Machinery makers (segment E) with 2-20 high-ticket RFQs a day; Digital Manufacturing pavilion is where they look for software. Visit the last 3 days after Plastivision and ACETECH.

stall.recommend: visit 25-27 Jan; consider a Digital Manufacturing pavilion pod in 2029
stall.hall_hint: Digital Manufacturing pavilion (Hall 5 in 2025 layout)

events.name: EngiExpo Surat 2027
events.category: Industrial engineering: machinery, tooling, fasteners, automation

footfall_history.note: organiser claim; Surat edition slightly smaller than Pune/Ahmedabad

events.why: Surat-Hazira engineering and textile-machinery owners; almost no SaaS vendors exhibit here. Flight connectivity from HYD is thin (check IndiGo direct, else via Ahmedabad).

stall.recommend: exhibit 9 sqm if Ahmedabad converted >=3 pilots; else visit
stall.hall_hint: Open ground; take the row facing the entrance gate

exhibitor_contact.how: email or online stall booking on engiexpo.com

events.name: ELECRAMA 2027

footfall_history.note: IEEMA reports 1,500+ exhibitors; organiser projects 350,000 visitors for 2027 (treat as marketing)

events.why: Every electrical distributor and cable/switchgear dealer in India walks ELECRAMA (segment B). Your Manikan Cables implementation plan is the case study to show here. Once every 2 years.

stall.recommend: exhibit: 12-18 sqm corner; book by October (space sells out)
stall.hall_hint: Halls 9-11 house the distributor and dealer pavilions; request the aisle between Hall 9 and the Reverse Buyer-Seller Meet zone

hotels.name: FabHotel / OYO Townhouse Knowledge Park
hotels.why: Aqua Line one stop to Knowledge Park II

hotels.name: Crowne Plaza Greater Noida
hotels.why: Standard ELECRAMA exhibitor hotel; book early

exhibitor_contact.how: email + Exhibit Enquiry Form on elecrama.com

events.name: India Pharma Expo 2027
events.why: Pharma distributors and packaging suppliers in Genome Valley quote on WhatsApp; regulated pricing limits automation depth. Home-city visit, 1 day.

stall.recommend: visit only
stall.hall_hint: n/a

events.name: Startup Mahakumbh 6.0
events.why: Investor and government visibility, not customers. Take the 13-14 Mar days after Pharma Expo if fundraising is on.

stall.recommend: apply for a subsidised startup pod only (B2B SaaS pavilion)
stall.hall_hint: B2B / Deeptech pavilion

events.name: Convergence India 2027 + INDELXPO 2027
events.why: INDELXPO brings electronics component distributors (segment A-adjacent); Convergence brings BSPs and telecom partners. Two-in-one visit.

stall.recommend: visit; AI Bharat pavilion pod only if subsidised
stall.hall_hint: AI Bharat Expo zone

events.name: India Automation & Robotics Expo 2027
events.why: System integrators and machine builders looking for Industry 4.0 software; good for the Vision AI and agentic OS story.

stall.recommend: visit; exhibit in 2028 if Vision AI is GA
stall.hall_hint: Hall 3

events.name: Fastener Fair India 2027

footfall_history.note: agent estimate; RX reports 8,000+ trade visitors

events.why: Pure segment A: every visitor is a fastener maker, importer or distributor with daily 'rate for 500 pcs?' messages. Small show, extremely dense.

stall.recommend: exhibit 9 sqm; the only software vendor in the hall wins by default
stall.hall_hint: Single hall; corner next to the distributor pavilion

exhibitor_contact.phone: RX India, DLF Cyber City, Gurugram
exhibitor_contact.how: exhibit enquiry form on fastenerfairindia.com (use the bookmarklet)

events.name: Automation Expo 2027
events.why: Asia's largest automation show; panel builders, instrumentation distributors and machine builders. Co-located week with Indexpo Mumbai: one trip, two shows.

stall.recommend: exhibit 9 sqm in the software/IIoT zone
stall.hall_hint: Hall 2 (main entrance side); avoid Hall 6 rear

events.name: Indexpo Mumbai 2027 (Industrial & Engineering Expo)

footfall_history.note: agent estimate; same organiser as the Hyderabad show you attended 4-6 Sep 2026

events.why: Same organiser and audience profile as Indexpo Hyderabad, so your Sept-2026 lead data is the benchmark. Walk it during Automation Expo.

stall.recommend: visit (stall already at Automation Expo same week)
stall.hall_hint: n/a

events.name: EngiExpo Jaipur 2027
events.why: Rajasthan marble-machinery, stone and hardware traders; decide in June based on EngiExpo Ahmedabad/Surat conversion.

stall.recommend: decide by June 2027
stall.hall_hint: JECC Hall A near Novotel entrance

events.name: Indexpo Hyderabad 2027 (Industrial & Engineering Expo)

footfall_history.note: agent estimate; replace with your own count from the 4-6 Sep 2026 visit

events.why: Your first expo (Sept 2026) as a visitor; 2027 is the year to exhibit at home with a year of case studies. Dates are the agent's projection until the organiser announces.

stall.recommend: exhibit 9-12 sqm corner; MSME PMS subsidy applies
stall.hall_hint: Hall 1 aisle between registration and the machine-tool anchors

exhibitor_contact.how: email; published rate ₹9,000/sqm + GST, MSME PMS subsidy
